"""Private operator guardian; external booking guard never replaces child auth."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from remoterf_device_core.integrations.supervision import CgroupSupervisor
BASE=Path('/tmp/remoterf-phase1c-cold-auth-20261109')
ENV=Path('/tmp/remoterf-phase1c-radio-final-20261109/env/bin/python')
BOOKING='52ae81ca-fd98-4e4c-8819-38cffa86247b:1022'
FRAMEWORK='8697958f27a1b1289cc45093258cb3eeed84bdb631cacc122a055f21a3a7d41a'
name=sys.argv[1];assert name in {'normal','limited'}
relative=Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::',1)[1]
manager=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/relative.lstrip('/')
assert manager.name=='manager' and manager.parent.name=='remoterf-phase1c-cold-'+name+'-20261109.service'
root=manager.parent;(root/'cgroup.subtree_control').write_text('+pids +memory')
state=BASE/name;state.mkdir(mode=0o700)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cold_guardian_lock',BASE/'usrp_handoff.py');helper=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
radio_lock=None
result={'passed':False,'started_at':time.time(),'booking':BOOKING,'framework_hash':FRAMEWORK,'serial':'32C78EE','transmit':False,'external_guard_patches_auth':False,'case_count':6,'case_deadline_seconds':240,'native_open_max_seconds':120,'parent_cgroup':str(root),'parent_cpu_max':(root/'cpu.max').read_text().strip(),'parent_memory_max':(root/'memory.max').read_text().strip(),'parent_pids_max':(root/'pids.max').read_text().strip(),'guardian_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cases':[],'authority_queries':0}
def write():
 (state/'guardian-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
def authority():
 result['authority_queries']+=1
 r=subprocess.run([str(BASE/'authority'),'--reservation-id',BOOKING,'--device-id','40','--serial','32C78EE'],capture_output=True,timeout=2)
 assert r.returncode==0 and len(r.stdout)<4096,'external booking provider failed'
 v=json.loads(r.stdout)
 assert v['active'] is True and (v['reservation_id'],v['device_id'],v['serial'],v['expires_at'])==(BOOKING,40,'32C78EE',1794290400),'external booking inactive'
 assert time.time()<v['expires_at'],'external booking ended'
 return v

def usb_free():
 devices=[]
 for serial in Path('/sys/bus/usb/devices').glob('*/serial'):
  try:
   if serial.read_text().strip()=='32C78EE':devices.append(serial.parent)
  except OSError:pass
 assert len(devices)==1,'reserved USB serial not unique'
 d=devices[0];node=Path('/dev/bus/usb')/('%03d'%int((d/'busnum').read_text()))/('%03d'%int((d/'devnum').read_text()))
 assert node.exists(),'reserved USB node unavailable'
 r=subprocess.run(['fuser',str(node)],capture_output=True,timeout=2)
 assert r.returncode==1 and not r.stdout.strip() and not r.stderr.strip(),'USB owner remains'
 return {'device_node':str(node),'owner_count':0}
supervisor=None;scope=None
try:
 radio_lock=helper.acquire_radio_lock('32C78EE')
 result['serial_lock_held']=True
 authority();assert time.time()<1794290400-300
 result['usb_before']=usb_free()
 supervisor=CgroupSupervisor(root,state/'processes',max_scopes=2,max_processes=1,max_pids=128,memory_bytes=512*1024*1024)
 for index in range(6):
  authority();assert time.time()<1794290400-300
  case=state/('case-%02d'%index)
  record={'index':index,'started_at':time.time(),'passed':False};result['cases'].append(record);write()
  owner='cold-%s-%02d'%(name,index)
  scope=supervisor.create(owner)
  scope_path=root/supervisor.describe()['owners'][owner]['name']
  command=[str(ENV),'-I',str(BASE/'usrp_cold_start.py'),'--backend','usrp','--guarded-scope',str(scope_path),'--case','valid','--serial','32C78EE','--device-id','40','--state-dir',str(case),'--evidence',str(case/'evidence.json'),'--expected-framework-hash',FRAMEWORK,'--authority-command',str(BASE/'authority'),'--reservation-id',BOOKING]
  env={'PATH':'/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin','HOME':str(Path.home()),'LANG':'C.UTF-8','LC_ALL':'C.UTF-8','XDG_CONFIG_HOME':str(case/'config'),'XDG_DATA_HOME':str(case/'data'),'XDG_CACHE_HOME':str(case/'cache'),'REMOTERF_CONFIG_DIR':str(case/'config/remoterf'),'GRPC_PORT':'50051','CERT_PORT':'50052','REMOTERF_BIND_HOST':'127.0.0.1'}
  proc=scope.launch(command,env=env,cwd=BASE)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+240;last_check=0
  while True:
   if time.monotonic()-last_check>=1:authority();last_check=time.monotonic()
   snapshot=scope.snapshot();rows=[v for v in snapshot['processes'] if v['id']==proc];assert len(rows)==1
   code=rows[0]['returncode']
   if code is not None:break
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'cold case exceeded 240 second deadline'
   time.sleep(.05)
  record['returncode']=code
  # Normal exit must independently release all descendants; otherwise preserve
  # a failure, kill only this identity-verified scope and do not run another case.
  until=time.monotonic()+5
  while not scope.resources_released() and time.monotonic()<until:time.sleep(.05)
  record['normal_scope_release']=scope.resources_released()
  record['scope_snapshot']=scope.snapshot()
  for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
   (state/('case-%02d-%s.log'%(index,stream))).write_bytes(scope.log_tail(proc,stream))
  assert record['normal_scope_release'],'descendant survived normal child exit'
  scope.close();scope=None
  record['usb_after']=usb_free()
  child=json.loads((case/'evidence.json').read_text());record['child']=child
  assert code==0 and child['passed'] is True,'cold child failed'
  assert child['first_open_seconds']<=120,'native open exceeded standard local client open budget'
  record.update(passed=True,finished_at=time.time());write()
 assert supervisor.describe()['owners']=={}
 supervisor.close();supervisor=None
 result['usb_after']=usb_free();authority()
 result.update(passed=True,finished_at=time.time())
except BaseException as exc:
 result['failure']={'type':type(exc).__name__,'frames':[{'file':Path(f.filename).name,'line':f.lineno,'function':f.name} for f in traceback.extract_tb(exc.__traceback__)[-8:]]}
 result['failed_at']=time.time()
 try:
  if scope is not None:
   result['failure_scope_stop_verified']=scope.stop(timeout=5)
   if result['failure_scope_stop_verified']:
    scope.close();scope=None
  if supervisor is not None and supervisor.describe()['owners']=={}:
   supervisor.close();supervisor=None
 except BaseException as cleanup_error:
  result['cleanup_failure_type']=type(cleanup_error).__name__
finally:
 try:write()
 except BaseException as evidence_error:
  result['evidence_write_failure_type']=type(evidence_error).__name__
  print('Evidence write failed; guardian retained for independent reconciliation.',file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
# Root stays alive after success/failure until the coordinator checks persisted
# identities, empty scopes, actual USB release and unchanged production state.
while not (state/'guardian.release').exists():time.sleep(.25)
assert json.loads((state/'processes/scopes.json').read_text())['scopes']=={}
assert not [p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and p.name!='manager']
assert usb_free()['owner_count']==0
if radio_lock is not None:os.close(radio_lock)
raise SystemExit(0 if result['passed'] else 1)

#!/home/prod-remoterf/miniconda3/envs/serverrf/bin/python
import argparse
import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import yaml

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--reservation-id', required=True)
p.add_argument('--device-id', required=True, type=int)
p.add_argument('--serial', required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
expected = '52ae81ca-fd98-4e4c-8819-38cffa86247b:1022'
assert (a.reservation_id, a.device_id, a.serial) == (expected, 40, '32C78EE')
root = Path.home() / '.config/remoterf'
rows = yaml.safe_load((root / 'devices.yml').read_text())['devices']
devices = [r for r in rows if r.get('device_id') == a.device_id]
assert len(devices) == 1 and devices[0]['device_type'] == 'usrp'
assert devices[0]['init'] == {'profile': 'usrp2901', 'type': 'b200', 'serial': a.serial}
with sqlite3.connect('file:' + str(root / 'db/reservations.db') + '?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=0.5) as db:
    rows = db.execute('SELECT username,device_id,start_time,end_time FROM Reservations WHERE res_id=?', (1022,)).fetchall()
assert len(rows) == 1
owner, gid, start, end = rows[0]
assert owner == 'ethange' and gid == a.device_id
def epoch(value):
    return datetime.datetime.strptime(value, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S').replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).timestamp()
start, end = epoch(start), epoch(end)
assert (start, end) == (1794286800, 1794290400)
print(json.dumps({'active': start <= time.time() < end, 'reservation_id': expected,
                  'device_id': gid, 'serial': a.serial, 'expires_at': end}))
